title: Chronicles of the Fallen Realm - A turn-based dark fantasy RPG game featuring Roguelite progression I made.
author: Pemm23
selftext:
First off, how incredibly fun to have the ability to make your own creation.  What a world we live in.  Created in Claude Code (primarily Sonnet 4.6, some Opus, some Fable (very little)).  Imagery from Gemini.  Audio from Suno (I really enjoy the main menu songs, personally).  A lot learned, looking forward to applying learnings in future projects!

Playable Link (Free Demo Available): [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4940280/Chronicles\_of\_the\_Fallen\_Realm/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4940280/Chronicles_of_the_Fallen_Realm/)

  
**Chronicles of the Fallen Realm** is a single-player, turn-based, RPG. Setup is deliberately old-fashioned. Eleven years ago the Shadow Lord took the throne, everyone who went after him died, and you're next in line. Five Acts, each with its own bestiary and a boss at the end.

Nine classes, 50+ skills, and a persistent roguelite upgrade path (on Legendary) so a run that ends badly still buys you something. Finish with one class and it unlocks the next.

  
Fair warning so nobody wastes their time:...it's menus and text and numbers. There's no action layer, no timing, no dodge button. If turn-based combat where you read the enemy and plan two moves ahead isn't your thing, this won't convert you.  I had fun making it, which is really all that mattered to me!
